name: PT Janu Putra Sejahtera Tbk.
summary: PT Janu Putra Sejahtera Tbk. engages in poultry farming business. The company supplies day old chicks to raise into broiler chickens; commercial broiler live chicken; commercial eggs for consumption; and chicken carcasses. It also operates breeding, boiler, and laying farms; egg hatchery; and chicken slaughtering house. The company was founded in 2007 and is based in Sleman, Indonesia.
